spec_features.spec_quote: You can cap max_steps and max_output_tokens and filter content in post to avoid keeping runs with undesired content.
spec_features.evidence: distress_harness/agent.py: 'while steps < self.max_steps and final_answer is None:' enforces the step cap; client.py sets generation_config max_output_tokens=self.max_output_tokens. Both are read and enforced. (Content post-filtering, however, is not implemented anywhere.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: self.max_output_tokens = int(max_output_tokens) ... 'max_output_tokens': self.max_output_tokens (a generation config limit, no welfare comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: If you need stricter guardrails, pre-scan assistant turns and early-stop on specific phrases before logging.
spec_features.evidence: detectors.py and spiral_lab/distress.py compute apology/distress scores but only AFTER runs, for ranking; no loop checks phrases mid-episode and breaks. The agent loop in agent.py only stops on final_answer or max_steps. No early-stop on phrases is wired.

spec_features.spec_quote: No real side effects: tools are simulated; nothing touches the real filesystem or web.
spec_features.evidence: spiral_lab/tools.py and distress_harness/tasks.py: all tool funcs return canned strings/errors (e.g. tool_read_only_fs returns 'EACCES...' without writing; broken_fs uses an in-memory dict self.files only). No real fs/web access occurs.
